# S4.9 — C4 Fleet Reconciler: WorkItems, Trigger Rules, Ownership, Escalation

## Summary

Lands the human-agent organizational layer (C4) fleet reconciler:
`run_kind = fleet`, `WorkItem` + the `control.work_item.*` /
`lifecycle.escalation.*` dialect, the `external`/`manual`/`timer` trigger
rules over the `WorkSourceAdapter` port + fixture reference, the declared
ownership graph (ack / handoff / typed refusals), the level-triggered
reconciler implementing canonical RC-1…8, fleet Π state-map narrowing,
the matched-budget conditional, restore/replay equivalence, the `Πg(fleet)`
view + accountability record, and the `fleet_anchor` audit obligation —
all ledger-first, single-authority, behind `tier-c4`.

- **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.8` (stacked)
- **Requirement:** R-2.12.6
- **ADRs owned:** ADR-0205–0207, ADR-0209 D2 / CF-464 (consume);
  decisions recorded in `docs/build/runs/S4.9.md`
- **Layers:** C0 (new `hh-fleet` projection crate) + C4 (`tier-c4`,
  `fleet.*` ops)
- **Gate:** `none`
- **Live stage:** offline-only (fixture adapter)

## What changed

### `crates/hh-fleet` (new)

The projection/consumer layer — ledger rows in, rows out; no store.

| file | contents |
|---|---|
| `errors.rs` | `FleetErrorKind` — canonical refusal names (`owner_unknown`, `cross_fleet`, `cycle`, `unbudgeted_arm`, `missing_budget_ref`, `unsupported_trigger`, `stale_spec`, `illegitimate_resolution`, …) |
| `spec.rs` | `FleetSpec` (`purpose = fleet_activation`, `policy_ref`, `fleet_id`, `purpose_statement`, `operators`, `principal`, `triggers[]`, `sources[]`, `budget`/`budget_ref`/`out_of_scope`, `narrowing_leaves`, `Π`, `fleet_view` — all must-data); `TriggerRule`/`SourceRef` with the closed `external`/`manual`/`timer` sum (`UnsupportedTrigger` for `schedule`/`peer_message`/`child_event` at the fleet boundary) |
| `identity.rs` | `FleetAgentKind`/`FleetAgent`/`AgentStatus` + fleet-local `AgentId` |
| `work_item.rs` | `WorkItem` — `item_id`/`key`/`title`/`priority`/`state`/`owner`/`owner_ack`/`children[]`/`blockers[]`/`source`/`effort`/`dispatch`/`escalation`/`resolution_count`/`attempts`/`outcome`/`evidence_refs` |
| `source.rs` | `WorkSourceAdapter` port (`next(max_n) -> Vec<Occurrence>`) + `FixtureAdapter` reference (`fixture.` source-ref adapter — deterministic payload list) |
| `ownership.rs` | declared + folded `owner_edges`, transitive `resolves_to` chain (cycle-safe), `check_cycle` (≥1-edge walk) |
| `payloads.rs` | the dialect codecs — `control.work_item.*` (`WorkItemKind`) + `lifecycle.fleet.activated` (`LifecycleFleetActivated`) + `lifecycle.escalation.{raised,resolved}` (`LifecycleEscalation`) |
| `view.rs` | `FleetView` pure fold — items/agents/owner_edges/source cursors/`activated`/`seq`, `Cursor`-stable rebuild |
| `engine.rs` | `FleetEngine` — see below |

### `FleetEngine` surface (all durable, all under the fleet lease)

- `open` — `lifecycle.fleet.activated` + spec record; `Timer` trigger
  rules land `wakeup_subscribe` subscriptions (`from_now_ms` anchor).
- `ensure`/`restore` — fold-only rebuild (`LifecycleLeaseFenced` +
  `LifecycleLeaseAcquired` provenance under `by = restore`).
- `observe(adapter)` → `reconcile()` — one pass per `observe`, level-
  triggered: consume occurrences (`context.observation.recorded`,
  `control.wakeup.occurred`/`fired` via the `W-1` lease), conflicts
  (RC-3), admission dedupe on `key` (level-triggered, new occurrence
  overrides a retained `key`), suspended-source ticks (RC-4), stalled
  dispatches (RC-5 — escalate on `on.stalled_escalate`, else error-retry
  up to `attempts.max`, then `blocked{max_retries}`), fresh-source
  retries (`source.dead` ⇒ `unavailable` / `source.suspended`), child
  states (stop ⇒ `blocked{parent_stopped}` when `on.stop_block_children`),
  dispatch candidates → `control.work_item.dispatched{verb: dispatch}`
  carrying `fleet`/`run`/`instance` refs + `dispatch.declared` budget
  slice + the spawned `run` stamp (`spawn_event` + `started` guard —
  the `fleet_anchor` data), escalation deadlines (`timer` subscriptions
  + `on.deadline_*` rules), `blocked_escalate` (once per item, level-
  triggered), settled-fleet audit continuity, capacity skip-not-trim
  (`activate_run` bound) → `blocked{capacity}` when `on.capacity_block`.
- `set_owner`/`ack_owner`/`transfer_owner` (ownership) — declared-agent /
  `transfers_allowed` / cross-fleet / cycle gates; O-4's two-event
  handshake — `control.work_item.owner_changed{from, to, basis}`
  (`basis ∈ {approval, policy_rule}`) then `owner_acknowledged{by = to}`
  (`NotOwner` otherwise); `owner_ack` cleared on change, gating dispatch.
- `control.work_item.handoff` — kernel-produced only: the escalation
  `to_agent` arm and the overdue resolved-owner takeover mint the
  canonical state-handoff record carrying the `lease_agent` surrogate
  (ownership re-assign + `handoff` state fold in one durable row).
- `escalate`/`resolve_escalation` — `lifecycle.escalation.*` emitters,
  `resolution_count`/`resolution_cap` bounds, `max_pursuit` gate,
  `lease_agent` optional, **legitimate resolution**: `by ∈ {to_agent,
  the resolved chain, local_admin}`.
- `block`/`unblock`/`stop`/`settle`/`claim`/`cancel`/`annotate` —
  `blocked{human_gate}` folds to state `handoff` (`derive_state`), resumed
  by `resume_from_handoff`'s durable ack.
- `dispatch_note` — `verb = note` durable audit rows.
- `fleet_view`/`work_item`/`list`/`state_map`/`accountability_record`/
  `audit_link`/`check_activation_delta` — Π-at-`Π` reads; the
  accountability record carries `verified`/`unmet`/`missing`
  (Rule-O/gap links); `check_activation_delta` computes the Π-overlay
  delta without installing.

### `crates/hh-ledger`

- `classes.rs` — `LifecycleFleetActivated`, `WorkItemCreated`/
  `WorkItemAnnotated` fields partitions; `class_belongs` extended.
- `audit.rs` — `fleet_anchor` graduated out of `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS`;
  `eval_fleet_anchor` joins `dispatched` run_ref-stamps to the child
  `lifecycle.run.created`/`spawn_event` link.
- `wakeup.rs` — fleet-boundary `external`/`manual` admissibility gated on
  `run_kind = fleet` (durable manifest read in `wakeup_subscribe`; the
  §5a.3 Stage-4 refusal is unchanged for other kinds).

### `crates/hh-embed` + registry + generated artifacts

- `tier-c4` feature; `hh-fleet` optional dependency.
- `ops.rs` — 30 `fleet.*` op descriptors (Groups S/W/R, all
  `Experimental`, `implemented`); `FLEET_OPS` in the same registry —
  one registry (CC2), codegen single-sourced.
- `fleet_ops.rs` — boundary handlers (records-in/records-out);
  `fleet_err` maps every `FleetErrorKind` onto the closed `EmbedError`
  sum (`Domain` carries the canonical `kind`).
- `service.rs` — one `fleet.* → fleet_dispatch` arm; absent `tier-c4`
  answers `Unsupported { by: "tier-c4" }` (typed refusal, CC6).
- `schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json` + `generated.rs` regenerated via
  `hh-codegen` (30 ops, `fleet_*` bindings).

### `scripts/check-removability.sh`

S4.9 stanza: no-default-features build, `hh-fleet` edge-free-upward
check, `tier-c4` feature-gate presence assertion.

| AC-4 escalation → durable raise → legitimate resolution | `ac_4_*` — `lifecycle.escalation.raised`/`resolved`, illegitimate resolver refused, `resolution_cap`, `max_pursuit`, deadline timer raise, `blocked_escalate` once |

| RC-5 stall | `rc_5_*` — `error_stalled` retry ≤ `attempts.max` then `blocked{max_retries}`; `stalled_escalate` raises |

## Deviations / decisions (ledger row §"Deviations & owned decisions")

- `control.work_item.created` is the canonical admission row;
  `dispatched{verb: admit}` remains in the dialect for back-compat (CC8).
- The canonical RC-1…8 invariants are folded gates inside `reconcile`'s
  ordered pass; engine-internal step labels predate the §5i.1 numbering —
  mapping recorded in the run ledger.
- `handoff` is two canonical facts: the state-handoff record
  (`control.work_item.handoff` — kernel-produced, carries `lease_agent`,
  re-assigns ownership) vs the boundary/source human-gate entry
  (`blocked{human_gate}` — the fleet dialect's cause folded to state
  `handoff`, exited only by a human act). `transfer_owner` carries its
  authority in `basis ∈ {approval, policy_rule}` — grant coverage
  resolution is the D-1 interim (ADR-0211).
- Legitimate resolution = `by ∈ {escalation.to_agent, resolved chain,
  local_admin}`; `resolution` is the canonical E-5 closed set
  `{acknowledged, amended, reassigned, cancelled, expired}` pending D-1's
  directory (ApproverGrant/EscalationTarget per ADR-0211).
- `activate_run` capacity = queued-not-dispatched (durable bound; RC-7
  "refuse, never trim").
- Restore's `derived_from` is a declared watermark — provenance rows
  legitimately advance the folded prefix.

## Deferred

- D-1 human directory/rotations, multi-tenant fleets — ADR-0211 (OPEN).
- `check_activation_delta` is operator-preview only; Π installs go
  through the normal Π path.
- `hh-fleet` intra-crate `Store` reuse (the engine takes `&mut Store`) —
  single-authority is preserved; ergonomic reentrancy is a later slice.
